seat_rates_note: Monthly list price per seat type. apply_roster.py fills each person's monthly_rate from this map using their seat_type in the roster, so the roster spreadsheet never needs a dollar column. Add one entry per seat type your plan actually has.
surface_b_method: MANUAL EXPORT is the primary path — claude.ai > Settings > Analytics > 'How much is Claude costing?' > Export spend report > Last Month, then drop the CSV into raw/<YYYY-MM>/overage_spend.csv. The authenticated in-page fetch (see SKILL.md) is an optional automation over an UNOFFICIAL endpoint.
surface_b_requires: A manual monthly export by an admin, OR (optional automation) an Owner/Primary Owner claude.ai session in Claude-in-Chrome.
notes: org_id is filled by the setup flow (grab it from your claude.ai admin URL). plan_tier: 'team' uses the manual/browser Surface B path above; 'enterprise' uses fetch_surface_b_enterprise.py against the documented Analytics API and never touches a browser.
api_cost_source_note: Where API (Console) cost comes from: 'admin_api' pulls it with your Admin key; 'ramp' reads it from Ramp's AI-spend connection (no key on this machine — Ramp holds it); 'none' skips it.
card_charges_source_note: 'ramp' adds Anthropic charges on employee cards from Ramp, shown beside the totals (not added to them). 'none' skips it.
dashboard_visibility_note: Who sees what on the shared Claude Dashboard: 'department' rolls people up to their department before anything is uploaded; 'person' uploads per-person rows (names, emails, spend). Everyone who can open the dashboard can download its rows, so choose 'person' only if that is your policy.
api_cost_refreshed_by_note: Which daily job refreshes API cost on the dashboard: 'mac' (the Mac job, default) or 'cloud' (a scheduled cloud routine reading Ramp, which keeps API cost current while the Mac is off).
